crossRefs.note: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

translations.web: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
translations.bsb: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
translations.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
translations.asv: To him that rideth upon the heaven of heavens, which are of old; Lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.
